card.name: Neovascular (wet) AMD headings
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words in eye-drug labels where age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is about to be named, mainly the closing parenthesis after "Neovascular (Wet" and the "(" before "AMD".

modes.label: Closing bracket after wet
modes.description: The ")" right after "Neovascular (wet" in a dosage heading, just before "Age-Related Macular Degeneration".

modes.label: Bracket before AMD
modes.description: The "(" after the full disease name, where the abbreviation AMD comes next.
